environment.description: Flask application deployed as ECS Fargate service behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 8080. No origin validation or CSRF protection middleware. SameSite=None on cookies allows cross-origin cookie attachment. Service is accessible at https://payments.example.com. No additional WAF or request filtering rules applied.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS with ACM certificate
